level1_releases.name: openclaw 2026.10.10-beta.3
level1_releases.body_excerpt:
## 2026.10.10-beta.3

### Highlights

- Windows reliability: restore fresh state initialization and Gateway startup, hide SQLite helper windows during app updates, and make forced Gateway reinstalls tolerate launcher timestamp settling. (#176194, #174969, #176174, #176945; related #176111, #174906, #176163, and #176872) Thanks @skyzhao1223, @RomneyDa, @easyteacher, @throwingbones, @tjarrau-dev, and @cnnceart.
- Upgrade recovery: converge app-owned plugins to the upgraded core version, restore affected agent stores including held system agents after schema-changing updates, and scope migration rollback backups to the versioned tables being changed. (#174257, #175007, #176783, #172671; related #174120 and #176669) Thanks @RomneyDa, @kazuyuki-eguchi, and @PennyVibe.

### Changes

### Fixes

- Agent state: concurrent initialization can no longer let two agents claim ownership of the same agent database. (#174251)
- Codex and native apps: previews no longer block replies after a context refresh, session replies resume after native child recovery, bound Codex history survives app-server restarts, and native app messages send again after reconnecting. (#177716, #177564, #172705, #171528) Thanks @jjjhenriksen and @RomneyDa.
- Background tasks: completions are no longer dropped when the config changes mid-turn. (#169529; related #169054) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666, @RomneyDa, and @Oldrich333.
- Discord: restore native slash commands in channels and threads. Thanks @montrellcruse and @RomneyDa.
- Agents: keep the prompt cache when a rate-limited run retries, and preserve steering messages that arrive without an explicit target. Thanks @montrellcruse, @RomneyDa, and @obviyus.
- Cron/CLI continuity: preserve CLI chat sessions across cron announce wakes instead of resetting their provider session. (#176218; related #176208) Thanks @eliavb43 and @RomneyDa.
- CLI tools: invalidate reused CLI sessions when the available tool catalog changes, restoring tools such as `exec` after Gateway restarts and preventing stale catalogs from reaching spawned agents. (#176577; related #175670) Thanks @RomneyDa, @jackylecalvez2, and @vincentkoc.
- GMI: omit unsupported `reasoning_effort` values on GPT-5.6 tool turns so the provider no longer rejects them with HTTP 400. (#176709) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Windows updates: recognize Scheduled Task permission denials in every Windows display language, keep Windows plugin dependency links across Doctor phases, and clean up backup scratch director

level1_releases.name: Hermes Agent v0.22.3
level1_releases.body_excerpt:
# Hermes Agent v0.22.3

**Release Date:** October 21, 2026

> Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~620 PRs merged since v0.22.2 into a stable release for the CLI and installer, the Microsoft Store app, Docker and Hermes Cloud. Full curated notes for this window ship with v0.23.0.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

## About this release

Measured at commit `5b147ab036d`, the window since v0.22.2 contains **2,911 non-merge commits** across **4,206 changed files** (+360,278 / −64,308), about **620 merged PRs** and **326 closed issues**.

Also in the window, undocumented here on purpose: MCP progress notifications streamed as live tool progress, a refreshed classic CLI layout (glyph transcript, status line under the composer, two-line header), OAuth clients that plugins declare and Hermes signs in and refreshes, `hermes plugins update` offering every available plugin update plus an Update button for git-installed plugins in Desktop, steering and editing a queued prompt from Desktop, a guided subagent model and provider picker in Desktop, a live `/loop` countdown row in the CLI and TUI, opt-in Telegram DM topic transfer, a `post_compaction` plugin hook, a capabilities catalog, the Microsoft Store build going live automatically when a release publishes, session auto-prune back to opt-in with a one-time prompt when disk runs low, Nemotron 3.5 Bolt and one-slot DFlash drafts in the local runtime, and dozens of new plugin catalog entries.

**Full curated release notes for this window ship with v0.23.0**, which will document everything from v0.22.0 onward — highlights, feature areas, and complete contributor credits. Nothing in this window is skipped.

## Updating

- Microsoft Store app: updates through the Store.
- Desktop app installed from the installer (.exe / .dmg): no change in this release; it updates with the next bundled release.
- CLI: `hermes update`, or re-run the installer one-liner.
- Docker / Hermes Cloud: `nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable` (or `:latest`).

**Full Changelog**: [v0.22.2...v0.22.3](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/compare/v0.22.2...v0.22.3)
